lines.en: I take a step; they take one back.
The horde parts a path by itself.
I walk on dead leaves, loud.

lines.zh: 它们跟在我后面，不敢近。
lines.en: They trail behind me, not daring closer.
My steps are steadier than theirs.

lines.zh: 前面有僵尸挡路，让开了。
lines.en: A zombie blocks the way and moves aside.
I am in no hurry; they can wait.
Nothing on this road dares touch me.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住三只小的。
lines.en: My shadow covers three of the small ones.
Where I pass, it is quiet.

lines.zh: 它们互相推挤，想跟上我。
lines.en: They shove each other trying to follow.
I look up; the sky is still early.
I stand; the horde rings me.
None of them dares speak first.

lines.zh: 我从怀里摸出一颗苹果。
lines.en: I fish an apple from my coat.
I bite; the juice is cold.
They watch me eat, throats rattling.
I drop the core by my feet.
No living scent on the wind.
It is too quiet; I do not like it.
My bones are harder than theirs.

lines.zh: 它们等一个命令，我不给。
lines.en: They wait for an order; I give none.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，它们也看。
lines.en: When you look at me, they look too.
My eyes are brighter than theirs.

lines.zh: 你数过围过来的僵尸吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the ones closing in?
I raise a hand and they halt.
Other living things run when they see me.

lines.zh: 我打量你，像看一颗苹果。
lines.en: I size you up like an apple.
Your breath has gone all uneven.
You carry the smell of iron and sweat.
They are already behind you.
I do not smile; I cannot.
That did not even break the skin.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看伤口，很小。
lines.en: I look at the wound; it is small.
Well aimed — just no strength behind it.

lines.zh: 尸群因为这一下兴奋起来。
lines.en: That blow excites the horde.
I give half a step — only half.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，又接上了。
lines.en: A bone cracks, then knits again.
The blade trembles in your hand.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
This small wound — I will remember it.
Whoever strikes me, I will find.
I know the gleam of a golden apple.
That glimmer in your hand — give it here.

lines.zh: 苹果我吃得多了，金的少。
lines.en: Apples I have eaten; golden ones, rarely.
I step forward, not from hunger.

lines.zh: 那味道能让我想起什么。
lines.en: That taste could bring something back.

lines.zh: 你把苹果举高，我看见了。
lines.en: You raise the apple; I see it.
I only want one bite.
Do not put it away.
The horde smells the sweetness too.
Golden things are always different.

lines.zh: 我撞开两只僵尸，继续走。
lines.en: I shove two zombies aside and walk on.
When they hit me, they back off.
Your shoulder touches mine, lightly.
The horde crowds in, then scatters.
I do not move; they go around.
You step back onto one of them.
That bump did not even sway me.

lines.zh: 它们撞成一团，我走中间。
lines.en: They pile up; I walk the middle.
Move aside; do not block the way.
I raise my hand; they scatter at once.
None of them dares come near.

lines.zh: 这算不算孤独，我不清楚。
lines.en: Whether that is loneliness, I do not know.
They fear me, and they hate me.
A space beside me stays empty.
There was one; they tore it apart.
I cannot recall her face.
Only apples keep me company now.
I will not look for another.

lines.zh: 尸群里没有同伴这个词。
lines.en: In the horde, there is no word for companion.

lines.zh: 我站着，它们跪着，都差不多。
lines.en: I stand, they kneel; it is much the same.
I bend and pick up an apple.
They stare at my hand.
This one is a little bruised.
I wipe it clean and pocket it.

lines.zh: 掉下的果子，一只都不许碰。
lines.en: Not one fallen fruit may be touched.

lines.zh: 我捡的东西，它们不敢碰。
lines.en: What I pick up, they dare not touch.
The cores on the ground are all mine.

lines.zh: 我把苹果举起来给它们看。
lines.en: I lift the apple to show them.
Not one dares reach out.
It is a little dignity, that is all.

lines.zh: 我看向你，所有的头都转过来。
lines.en: I look at you; every head turns.
The horde goes suddenly quiet.

lines.zh: 它们闻到了我闻到的东西。
lines.en: They smell what I smell.
You are the only focus now.
I raise my hand and they start moving.
There is nothing else alive here.
I look only at your throat.

lines.zh: 它们分两路，绕到你后面。
lines.en: They split in two and circle behind you.
I do not shout; no need.

lines.zh: 你听见身后的动静了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear what is behind you?
The ring they form draws tighter.

lines.zh: 两百点生命，我很有耐心。
lines.en: Two hundred points; I can be patient.
I step out from among them.
Running now is already too late.

lines.zh: 我一停下，整片林子都停了。
lines.en: When I stop, the whole wood stops.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走，它们小跑跟着。
lines.en: I walk slowly; they trot after me.
One hand will be enough.
You back into the corner; I see it.
They go first; I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我的脚步压过它们的叫声。
lines.en: My steps drown out their cries.
Ten paces left; very close.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，我等你举稳。
lines.en: You raise your weapon; I wait for it to steady.
I raise my arm; there is no armor on it.
They clear a space on either side of me.
This time I will use everything.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住一百点。
lines.en: Your armor will not stop a hundred.

lines.zh: 从你进门起我就没移开视线。
lines.en: Since you came in, I have not looked away.

lines.zh: 后面那只已经抓住你了。
lines.en: The one behind has already got you.
I need only one chance.
I take three steps; they take five.

lines.zh: 你数我的血，我数你的命。
lines.en: You count my health; I count your lives.

lines.zh: 我用余光看你，它们正眼看。
lines.en: I glance at you; they stare.
No need to pick a foe; there is only me.

lines.zh: 我一只手按下去，你飞出去。
lines.en: I press one hand down; you fly back.
A hundred points; once is enough.
Your armor splits; you are still there.
I used no weapon, only my arm.
The horde stops to watch you land.
That blow went through your shield.
I brush the dust from my hand.
You are not steady, and here I come again.

lines.zh: 它们跟着扑上来，抢剩下的。
lines.en: They pile on, fighting for the rest.
I never strike twice.
The sound of bone is crisp.

lines.zh: 你滑出去一丈，撞在树上。
lines.en: You slide ten feet and hit a tree.
I stay where I am, not chasing.

lines.zh: 这就是它们怕我的原因。
lines.en: This is why they fear me.
I raise my hand; they raise theirs.
You are knocked flying into the horde.

lines.zh: 尸群突然让出一片空地。
lines.en: The horde suddenly clears a space.
I rise in the middle of it.
Two hundred points — that is rare.
They gather, then hold back.

lines.zh: 我身上没有伤，也没有土。
lines.en: No wounds on me, no soil either.
The light fails; good.
A few apples lie scattered on the ground.
I pick one up and bite it first.
They wait for me to lead.
There will be many living here.

lines.zh: 我数了数围过来的数量。
lines.en: I count how many have come.
Too few; more must gather.
I raise my hand; the horde follows.
The night is long; no hurry.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的外套，我不慌。
lines.en: Fire takes my coat; I am calm.
The impact of my landing runs through the horde.
Water fills my chest; it does nothing.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻了半片尸群，我站着。
lines.en: The blast flings half the horde; I stand.

lines.zh: 一根箭挂在我肩头，我不拔。
lines.en: An arrow hangs in my shoulder; I leave it.

lines.zh: 光灼过我的皮肤，留下白印。
lines.en: Light sears my skin and leaves a white mark.
I am hungry, but hunger will not break me.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，尸群散开。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; the horde scatters.
I fall and fall; it is very quiet.
